admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Desk note for the week. Approvals of the small purchases rest with the steward, as the standing order provides. The tradesmen's slips are gathered in the wire basket each morning, and the week's accounts are balanced on the last evening. The pantry orders went out on the second day and the candle order on the fourth. Nothing in the standing order was altered this week, and the desk closes each evening at the usual hour. The ledger is kept in the desk drawer, and the key hangs where it has always hung.
